Question:
Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

WITH ordered_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        n.name,
        m.id as movie_id,
        m.date_published,
        m.duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes,
        LAG(m.date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY dm.name_id ORDER BY m.date_published) as prev_date
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),
inter_duration AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        name,
        duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        prev_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL THEN 
                ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_published - prev_date)) / 86400.0)
            ELSE NULL
        END as days_between_movies
    FROM ordered_movies
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        name,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        SUM(duration) as total_movie_duration,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
        SUM(total_votes) as total_votes,
        MIN(avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(avg_rating) as max_rating
    FROM inter_duration
    GROUP BY name_id, name
),
director_inter_duration AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        ROUND(AVG(days_between_movies)) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM inter_duration
    GROUP BY name_id
)

WITH director_years AS (
    SELECT 
        d.name_id,
        m.year,
        LEAD(m.year, 1, NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY d.name_id ORDER BY m.year) as next_year
    FROM director_mapping d
    JOIN movies m ON d.movie_id = m.id
),
movie_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        year,
        next_year,
        CASE WHEN next_year IS NOT NULL THEN next_year - year ELSE NULL END as gap
    FROM director_years
),
avg_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        ROUND(AVG(gap), 0) as avg_inter_movie_duration
